text.tspan: Billion-scale virtual screening to identify pan-engaging
ligands of essential M. tuberculosis tRNA synthetases
Arnau Comajuncosa-Creus1, Konrad Mostert2, Gemma Turon1, Erick Strauss2, Miquel Duran-Frigola1
2Department of Biochemistry, Stellenbosch University, Stellenbosch, South Africa
Tuberculosis: a major global health thread
Structural characterization of essential tRNA synthetases
- Open Source AI for Global Health
Tuberculosis remains a global health thread, ... ... In this project, the main objective is to prioritise a set of purchasable or easily synthesizable
compounds with multi-target binding against the tRNA synthetases family, many ... have been identified as highly vulnerable in Mtb. To do so,
we implement a computational pipeline aimed at ...
In a CRISPR genetic screening, 21 Mtb tRNA synthetases were identified
as highly vulnerable genes in various processes, including novel targets for drug
discovery. First, we structurally characterized these proteins, gathering data
from multiple sources such as AlphaFold2, AlfaFold3, Swiss-Model and the PDB,
among others. Then, we identified potentially druggable pockets in their structures
using P2Rank and mapped protein residues to their corresponding Interpro domains
(e.g. catalytic domain, anticodon binding domain, editing domain, etc).
